name: prospector
description: Lead-generation system for a web-redesign business: gather companies within a defined scope, store rich dossiers (sector, revenue, employees — not website quality), capture + taste-audit their websites, score the money×bad-site×site-matters opportunity, deep-capture committed redesigns into a full blueprint (multi-page screenshots + code + issue register + implementation plan), and run an outreach workspace (agent-drafted email + copy-paste text → validate the contact → send now or as a bundle via SMTP). Runs locally (`npm start`, loopback) or hosted in a container with shared-password auth (set PROSPECTOR_PASSWORD; see DEPLOY.md): an HTML dashboard over a filesystem store, a watch-loop for deterministic actions (incl. outreach-save/send), and a headless `claude` agent-runner that drains hunt/deep-dive/outreach/blueprint autonomously — no separate Claude session required.
